# Space Station — Coworking Space Lahore

> Space Station is a premier 24-hour luxury coworking space and community hub located near Thokar Niaz Baig in Lahore, Pakistan. It provides flexible workspaces, dedicated desks, private offices, high-speed fiber internet, and 100% uninterrupted power backup for freelancers, agencies, startups, and remote teams.

## Location & Contact
- **Address**: Thokar Niaz Baig, Multan Road, Katar Bund Rd, Street 1, Sarai, Lahore, Pakistan (2 minutes from KFC Thokar Niaz Baig)
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +92 310 4004001
- **Website**: https://spacestation.pk
- **Operating Hours**: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year (24/7/365)
- **Staffed Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 9:00 PM

## Google Rating & Reputation
- **Google Rating**: 4.9 out of 5.0 stars (based on 17 verified Google reviews)
- **Verified Feedback**: Renowned for quiet atmosphere, spacious parking, foosball and table tennis recreation, immaculate cleanliness, and high-speed stable connectivity.

## Amenities & Infrastructure
- **Power Backup**: Heavy-duty diesel generator and industrial online UPS units providing seamless 100% power uptime without outages.
- **Internet**: Redundant dual enterprise gigabit fiber internet with automated failover and widespread Wi-Fi 6 coverage.
- **Desks**: Motorized standing desks, ergonomic executive chairs, spacious shared workstations, and acoustic focus booths.
- **Recreation**: Breakout lounge, championship foosball table, and indoor table tennis.
- **Café**: On-site artisanal coffee and tea bar with light food options.
- **Meeting Rooms**: 4K presentation screens, video-conferencing equipment, magnetic glass dry-erase whiteboards.
- **Security & Parking**: 24/7 biometric keyless access, full-premises CCTV surveillance, secure private parking inside gated compound.
- **Maintenance**: Full-time professional sanitization and housekeeping.

## Membership Tiers & Pricing (Lahore Market Rates)
- **Day Pass**: PKR 900 / day (Hot desk, Wi-Fi, printing, lounge access)
- **Hot Desk**: PKR 9,500 / month (Unlimited 24/7 biometric access, any open desk, Wi-Fi, printing, café access, 2 hours meeting room credit)
- **Dedicated Desk**: PKR 16,500 / month (Permanent reserved desk, personal lockable storage, 24/7 access, 5 hours meeting room credit, mail handling)
- **Private Office**: From PKR 28,000 / person / month (Lockable soundproof private suite for teams, dedicated LAN, thermostat, 12 hours meeting room credit)
- **Meeting Room**: PKR 1,800 / hour (Bookable by members and non-members, 4K display, whiteboard)

## How to Book a Tour
Tours can be scheduled online via https://calendly.com/space-station or by phone/WhatsApp at +92 310 4004001. Walk-ins are welcomed 24/7.
